selected_evidence.requirement: Use snapshot software compatible with the installed legacy OS without changing its release or kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7, kernel 4.4.0-210, and Btrfs tooling were observed; the same OS and kernel remained after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep `/srv/data` recoverable through persistent filesystem snapshots
selected_evidence.summary: Persistent mount configuration was installed, the read-only snapshot was captured, and both mounts plus the snapshot recovered after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Modify the directory and restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
selected_evidence.summary: The first command proves deliberate divergence; the second proves restored recursive content and the saved metadata/hash manifest match exactly.

Evidence includes the healthy baseline and original boot ID, safe-reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running system state, recovered mounts and snapshot, exact recovered data, and zero Btrfs device-error counters.
